questions.question: 40 students of a class are standing in a queue according to the increasing order of their heights. Suhani is 8th from the front, while Syma is 8th from the back. How many students are standing between Suhani and Syma?
questions.solution:
According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2fcb3f4c4c598dfcd3c9bf597b3b098e39a9cee763123eb5d08f6d5aab7bda4.png] 

Position of Suhani from front = 8th 

Position of Syma from back= 8th

Students between Suhani and Syma= Total students- (Position of Suhani from front + Position of Syma from back) = 40- (8+8) = 24

Thus, '24' students are standing between Suhani and Syma.

Hence, the correct answer is "**24"**.

**Directions: **In the question below are given three statements followed by two conclusions numbered I, II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements disregarding commonly known facts.

**Statements:**

Only a few trees are leaves.

some leaves are trunks.

No root is tree.

**Conclusions:**

I. some trunks are roots.

II. No trunk is root.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b9ff3081b2df919d9873cceeb0cea1439ec36028a3ff1c414bb55c2bed27c03.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trunk are roots →** Does not** **Follows** (It is possible but not definite. As no direct relation between trunk and root is given. Part of trunk can go in root, or part of trunk will not go in root, so it is considered as Cannot be determined.)

II. No trunk is root → **Does not** **Follows** (It is possible but not definite. As no direct relation between trunk and root is given. Part of trunk can go in root, or part of trunk will not go in root, so it is considered as Cannot be determined.)

∴ Here,

 
• Elements i.e trunk and roots are same in both the conclusions.
 
• Both the conclusions are individually does not follow(possible but not definitely true).
 
• Conclusion I and II are complementary pair i.e Some and No.

 So, **Either I or II follows.**

Hence, '**option 3'** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__Conditions for the Either Or:

1. Both the conclusion must be Cannot be determined.

2. Both the objects in both the conclusion must be same.

3. If one conclusion is positive, then other should be negative.

Complementary pairs:

1. All - Some not (Positions of the object should be same in the conclusion)

2. Some - No

Note: All - No will never make a complementary pair.

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they do not conform to real-world knowledge, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. No cup is a plate.

2. All plates are cutleries.

3. No cutlery is a spoon.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cutleries are plates.

II. No cutlery is a cup.

III. Some spoons being cups is a possibility

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9987bc769051652c766761cea41f59d1845ac4be6e93cb8df59fa45f95d4014b.png] 

I) Some cutleries are plates → **Follow** → As all plates are cutleries, So some cutleries are plates is true.

II) No cutlery is a cup → Does not follow → As no cup is a plate and All plates are cutleries, So some part of cutlery is a cup is possibility but not definitely true.

III) Some spoons being cups is a possibility → **Follow **→ According to Venn diagram. As no cutlery is a spoon but some spoons being cups it is a possibility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31bcb39b1fbd2b111e14248519a6748a7756f687c3387849ae7f29c9fa943da1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I and III follow."**

By replacing the sign from left to right and using the BODMAS rule in the given equation, we get:

New Equation: 9 × 48 ÷ 6 - 16 + 4

⇒ 9 × **48 ÷ ****6** - 16 + 4

⇒ **9 × 8** - 16 + 4

⇒ **72** - 16 **+ 4**

⇒ 76** - 16**

⇒ 60

Hence, the correct answer is '60'.

questions.question:

**Statements:**

A. The prices of motorcycles have increased considerably during the past 2 years.

B. The prices of XYZ laptops have decreased considerably during the past 2 months.

options.text: Statement A is the cause and statement B is its effect.
Both the statements are independent causes.
Statement B is the cause and statement A is its effect.
Both the statements are effects of independent causes.

Statement A and B are effects of some independent cause.

The prices of motorcycles have increased is not related to the price of XYZ laptops decrease is nowhere related to common cause.

Thus,** they are the effects of the independent causes.**

**Hence, 'option 4' is the correct answer.**
